record.body:
## Orientation

Territory: wave 3 is only estimate-chips. You own `dashboard/task_detail.py`, `tests/test_dashboard_estimate.py`, and the existing chip assertions in `tests/test_dashboard_app.py` in `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--estimate-view` (branch `phase/estimate-view`). `estimate-model` and `estimate-table` are already in this worktree and are frozen. Do not edit `dashboard/model.py` or `dashboard/tasks.py`. Do not edit `contract/`, `.artifacts/`, or `~/adaptive-artifacts`. Do not commit. Do not call `adaptive-artifacts`.

A shell function named `adaptive-artifacts` points at `~/.artifacts/se-workflow`, which is not this repo. Leave it unused.

Write the pilot first and confirm it fails, then implement. Run pytest from the worktree with `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest`.

## Requirements

R6: Task detail shows chips for the size when set, `{n}m` when set, and `executor inline` or `executor subagent`.

## Invariants

Header minutes are the wave rule, not the sum of every task. A missing estimate is omitted on the task and counted as unset on the phase. A missing size is omitted. A missing executor is `subagent`. Suffixes survive clipping. The dashboard stays read-only.

## Assumptions

`run-facts` has shipped `size` and `estimate_minutes`. Counted tasks are `planned`, `in_progress`, and `done`. The `Size:` line is the one `plan-phase` already writes. Work-items are listed with `--full`.

## Decisions

estimate-titles: Show the sitting phrase and derived elapsed minutes on the phase title, and size, estimate_minutes, and executor on the task title. Task detail repeats them as chips. A partial estimate shows the minute total and an unset count.

glance-run-facts: Defer dashboard display until size and estimate_minutes are stored. A later phase shows the sitting line and executor as title suffixes.
